```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)

stim <- read_csv(here("stim","sentence_completion_task","sentence-completion_rhotic.csv")) %>%
  mutate(
    stimulus = str_replace(
      port_sentence,
      fixed(lexical_item),
      str_dup("_", str_length(lexical_item))
    )
  )
```

```{r, results='asis'}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(stim))) {

  cat("#\n\n")

  cat(sprintf(
    "![](../images/%s.avif){width=50%%}\n\n",
    stim$sentence_code[i]
  ))

  cat(stim$stimulus[i], "\n\n")
}
```
